meta.source: CDC National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS), data.cdc.gov Socrata + US Census Bureau population estimates
meta.value: combined = legionellosis + pertussis + tuberculosis + meningococcal (annual case counts); rate = combined per 100,000 population

rate_ramp.note: fixed domain across all years incl Puerto Rico; use for a comparable color ramp

rate_ramp_states_dc_only.note: max is a small-state outlier (Alaska 2024, pertussis outbreak + high TB); for a readable animation cap the top of the color ramp near p95/p98 and clamp higher values to the top color

meta.license: US public domain (CDC NNDSS, US Census Bureau)
meta.provisional_note: Counts are NNDSS finalized year-end cumulative (max weekly cumulative). 2025 is the latest full year. Current-year (2026) provisional via live endpoint, not in this file.
